msg: --lr-anneal-epochs < --epochs: the LR cosine completes BEFORE the run ends; the tail runs at --lr-end (or held per --lr-hold-frac). Intended for a control-reproduction / warm-start arm; verify this is what you want.

--muon-start-epoch < --l7-start-epoch: the Muon finisher engages BEFORE the l7_softplus stage forms the partition. PR95 places Muon as the FINAL stage; an orthogonalized finisher on a not-yet-formed partition is likely weaker d_seg. ALLOWED (operator freedom); set >= --l7-start-epoch for the PR95 placement.
